description_en: Mati Bāhāḥ is a privatevihāralocated in a small courtyard to the north east of Nakabahī. It can be accessed from a narrow street leading from Nakabahī to Tapāhitī through a narrow alley with statues of Māhākāla and Gaṇeśa to the right and left. The area surrounding thisvihārawas called Mati Gā̃ or Mati Gāũ in previous times. The north-facing, three-storied main building of thebāhāḥconsists of a carved main door flanked by two small lattice windows (tikijhyāḥ) on the ground floor, and an elongated window with a row of five small openings(pasūkājhyāḥ) on the first floor as a symbol of the Pañcabuddha.The courtyard contains asikharopariviṃva caityaand ayajña kuṇḍaand is surrounded by residential buildings. Only one building, which is attached to the monastic building to the east, is a historical one, with preserved carved windows. The building at the northeast corner of the courtyard collapsed in the 2015 earthquake. The courtyard is paved with flat stones and is surrounded by a shallow plinth that runs around its outskirts with an apron rainwater drain.Above the window are paintings of Pañcabuddha and ajaṃkuritual (which is celebrated when a man becomes 77 years, 7 months and 7 days). The second floor is furnished with a largersvapājhyāḥ(three windows) with two aedicules in either sides covered by overhanging CGI sheet roof. Six plain struts (ṭuḍāla) support the roof. The ground and first level are separated by typical carved wooden cornices. The condition of the roof and the base of theṭuḍālasshow that two of them have already collapsed. The traditional roof has been replaced with corrugated galvanized iron sheets. There is no pinnacle on the top of the roof. The masonry wall area of the first and second floor above thepasūkājhyāḥand to the sides of thesvapājhyāḥhave been painted with pictures of Buddhist deities and other Buddhist rituals and figures.Akṣobhya Buddha is situated to the right of the main door which is unusal as generally, the main deity of a Buddhist monastery is installed in front of the main door. There is notoraṇaabove the main entrance and no stone lions are guarding thevihāra.Thesikharopariviṃva caityain front of the shrine is of a unique design. The base is aviṃaśatikoṇaplan, and is raised by a stone plinth. A serpent (nāga) winds across the lower story with its head and tail facing north in a mountain-like design. On top of this are four Buddhas facing in all four cardinal directions. The other four images seem to have been installed later and can be found between these Buddhas. The primary trio (gajū,gvaḥand drum) rest on a triple-layered lotus throne (padmāsana). The overall height of this Caitya is 135 cm above ground level.
description_ne: मति बाहा: नक बहीको उत्तरपूर्वतर्फ रहेको छ । अझै तोकेर भन्दा नक बहीबाट तपा हिटी जाने गल्लीबाट पूर्वपट्टि यो बाहा: रहेको छ । यो बाहा:भित्र प्रवेश गर्न एउटा साँघुरो गल्ली छ । प्रवेशमार्गको दायाँबायाँ महाकाल र गणेशको प्रतिमा छन् । बाहा: प्राङ्गणको दक्षिणपट्टि उत्तराभिमुखबाहा:को प्रमुख भवन रहेको छ । बाहा: प्राङ्गणको अन्य आवासीय घरहरूद्वारा घेरिएको छ ।बाहा:को भवनसँग जोडिएको प्राङ्गणको उत्तरपट्टि रहेको भवन मात्र ऐतिहासिक देखिन्छ जसमा कुँदिएका झ्यालहरू छन् । प्राङ्गणको ईशान कोणमा रहेको भवन २०७३ को भूकम्पमा भत्कियो । प्राङ्गणमा ढुङ्गा छापिएको छ र चारैतर्फ पानी जाने नाली बनाइएको छ । प्राङ्गणमा एउटा शिखरोपरि बिम्ब चैत्य र एउटा यज्ञकुण्ड रहेको छ ।बाहा:को गर्भगृहमा प्रवेश गर्ने ढोका कुँदिएका छन् र ढोकाको दायाँबायाँ टिकी झ्या रहेका छन् । पहिलो तलामा पञ्चबुद्धको प्रतीक पासुका झ्या छ । झ्याको माथि पञ्चबुद्धको र जंकुको (७७ वर्ष, ७ महिना, ७ दिन पुगेको वृद्धको जंकु गरिन्छ) भित्तेचित्र कोरिएको छ । दोस्रो तलामा ठुलो स्वपा झ्या छ जसको दुईतर्फ साना झ्यालहरू रहेका छन् । ती साना झ्यालहरूमुनि सालभञ्जिकाको भित्ते चित्र कोरिएका छन् । छानालाई थाम्न ६ वटा सादा टुँडाल राखिएका छन् । छानाको अवस्था र टुँडाल अड्याउने ठाउँ देख्दा त्यहाँका दुई वटा टुँडाल पहिल्यै खसेर हराएको कुरा थाहा पाइन्छ । पुरानो छाना फेरेर नयाँ राखिएको जस्तापाताको छाना पनि पुरानो भएर झर्न थालेको देखिन्छ । छानाको माथि गजुर छैन । सामान्यतया विहारको प्रमुख देवताको प्रतिमा मुख्य प्रवेश द्वारको सिधै अगाडि रहेको हुन्छ तर यस विहारमा अक्षोभ्यको मूर्ति ढोकाको दायाँपट्टि गर्भगृहको पश्चिम भागमा पूर्व फर्किएर रहेको छ ।बाहा:को मूल प्रवेशद्वारको माथि तोरण छैन र अन्य बाहा:मा हुने जस्तो प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँबायाँ सिंहको मूर्ति पनि छैन । यो विहार अन्य कुनै विहारको शाखा नभएर स्वतन्त्र एवं व्यक्तिगत विहार हो ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Rebuilt
